messages.content: For user ops_user_17, please check the current time in Europe/London, then find an Office 365 meeting room for at least 8 people on 2026-02-22 at 09:00. After that, check Alice’s availability using calendar item ID u_alice for that date, and archive the 09:00–10:00 availability as “Meeting Availability Archive” by email. Then scan devices in the living_room area, find the smart lock with ID lock_main, and lock the main door using PIN 2026. Next, check MSFT and sell 5 shares. Create a document titled “Office Security and Trade Execution Log” with the trade result and the tags office, security, and finance, then get the first tag from that list. Finally, email “Order executed successfully” to facilities@company.com and trading-ops@company.com with the subject “Office Availability, Lock Security, and Trade Status.”
